frequency: census (five-yearly); 2011 = the voluntary National Household Survey
unit: % of private households (owners ÷ households, by the age of the primary household maintainer)
transformations: 1971–2006 five-year rates = the 2010 study's birth-cohort table re-indexed to census years (census = cohort start + age start + 5); its '75+' cohort cell is labelled '75 to 79 years'
1971–2006 broad groups and 'All ages (20 and over)' = the study's Text table 2
2011/2016/2021 rates = owners ÷ all private households in the age group; 2011 has ten-year groups only
2021 covers Canada, the provinces and territories, and every CMA (single-detached owners as well)
notes: Maintainer definitions changed: 1971 and 1976 identified a household head; from 1981 the person paying the shelter costs; from 1991 the first person listed (the study's own note). 2011 = NHS, voluntary, GNR 26.1%.
